disequilibrium-changes-gaps.alt: Bike helmet market with equilibrium at $40 and 60 helmets: at $30 there is a shortage of 30 helmets (70 demanded, 40 supplied); at $50 there is a surplus of 30 (80 supplied, 50 demanded).

disequilibrium-changes-double.alt: Left: demand and supply both increase, so quantity rises but the price change is indeterminate. Right: demand increases and supply decreases, so the price rises but the quantity change is indeterminate.
